name: Curve pullback with demand retention
hypothesis: Buy the first higher low after a pullback while real reserve growth over the longer window remains positive.
spec: Setup: A slowing curve after early acceleration may reset entry cost without ending demand. Entry: Buy the first higher low after a pullback while real reserve growth over the longer window remains positive. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the pullback low or when real quote reserves trend down. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
